display.$description: Display mode for the breadcrumb navigation landmark.

gap.$description: Space on both sides of each CSS-generated separator.

separator-content.$description: CSS content for separators between trail items, including required quotes (for example, `"/"` or `"›"`).

separator-ink.$description: Color of the decorative CSS-generated separators.

ink.$description: Color of authored native links in the trail.

ink-current.$description: Color of the current native link or plain-text crumb. Zebkit links retain their own token surface.

decoration-line-current.$description: Text-decoration line applied to the current native link or plain-text crumb.

wrap.$description: Flex wrapping behavior for the ordered trail.
